content.short: On-chain billboard where one creator owns the spotlight for an hour for 1 USDC.
content.description: Booztory sells attention in one-hour slots. A creator pays 1 USDC to put their content in the live spotlight, and if nobody is queued it goes up immediately. There is no algorithm choosing what appears, and every slot stays recorded on-chain. It runs on Base and World Chain, with versions for Farcaster and World App.
content.meta: Pay 1 USDC to feature your content for an hour on Booztory's on-chain spotlight, on Base and World Chain.
